caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a stylized bird figurine standing upright on a small base. The bird has a prominent, rounded head with a curved beak, painted in yellowish-green with some brown and red accents around the eyes and beak area. The eyes are large and rounded with a dark, defined iris. The body of the bird has a mottled pattern of colors, primarily yellow, red, brown, and green, giving the appearance of textured feathers. The wings are depicted with elongated, overlapping feather shapes, primarily colored in red and yellow tones. The tail feathers continue the same color scheme. The legs are thick and yellow, ending in green claws that rest on a greenish, rock-like base. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery present in the composition.
title: Pa. German Parrot
